origin.derivedFrom: no contract basis — an empty reply is not a response

note: A closed connection with no bytes. IPS.exe has two traced paths that accept a connection and answer nothing at all: wsWaiterPad_DataArrival exits silently when NOT HandheldLicensed (VA 0x0281577a) and when NoReceiving is set (VA 0x028157fa). Silence is therefore a real protocol outcome, not only a network failure — and it is indistinguishable from a lost reply.
